_comment: TC-036: the PostgREST requests the patient app makes to file a lab report (upload) and a manually entered biomarker. Pinned on both sides: flutter_app/test/data/health_data_repository_lab_report_writes_test.dart proves the Dart repository sends exactly these requests, and tests/integration/patient-lab-report-writes.test.ts proves they are accepted by the real migrated schema + RLS through PostgREST. {patient_id} is the signed-in patient's auth user id, {org_id} their clinic (read first with org_lookup, because lab_reports_self_insert requires the patient's own org_id), {object} the uuid file name the app uploaded into the private lab-reports bucket, {today} the local date (YYYY-MM-DD). Patients can INSERT lab_reports but never UPDATE or DELETE them (RLS, by design), so each manual entry files a new one-marker report.
